fact: Newsmada reports that Madagascar's Registre social unique already covers about 2.7 million households, close to 12 million people.
Newsmada reports eight more districts are joining the 20 already covered, and a new survey is under way to update the data and extend the registry into urban areas.
L'Express reports that, per the Ministry of Population and Solidarities, over 2.6 million households are in the Registre social unique, up from 990,000 in February 2023.
L'Express reports a mass registration campaign in 99 districts until December 2026, aiming at national coverage.
PREA reports the RSU / e-Fokontany technical committee met on 5 February 2026, with field operations to resume within two weeks and completion scheduled for September 2026.
